assets.title: Dryland Bent-Blade Grass Clump
assets.description: Original S02 hard-edge faceted dryland grass tussock: twenty-four slender folded blades form three unequal grounded leaf fans, with an upright central crown and lower outward-bending secondary crowns. Each narrow blade has a shaped midrib, closed thin volume, varied arch and single tapering tip. Olive new growth and ochre older outer leaves support the low dryland silhouette without seed stems, reed culms or a soil pedestal. Metre scale, ground origin Z=0; named editable leaves and basal crowns. Solid PBR, no external textures, wind rig, animation or collision mesh. Independently authored geometry, not a scaled or recoloured wetland grass variant.
